_about: What the play bot (tools/balance_sim) checks a run against, so an audit sees a broken economy as a failure, not a number to read (owner, 19 Nov: 'the auditing should take care of it'). Each is checked on runs of at least min_days; style limits a target to bot styles that play that part of the game.

idle_days_most.note: most share of days (%) with coins sitting idle past the bot's limit

upkeep_least.note: least share (%) of coins earned that repairs take

upkeep_most.note: most share (%) of coins earned that repairs take
